payload.message: 我们现场判断是 FR 电机控制器的问题：遥控器报的就是码 7（FR 电机故障）。10/21 已经换过一个控制器，可能新换的这个也有问题，再换一个应该就好了。

steps.label: Read the report and earlier results

result.reply: 数据不支持“再换一个控制器就好”。码 7 确实是 FR 的 DTC 0x2A11 母线欠压，不是电机本体故障。新控制器 10/28 照样跳，而包电压已被拉到 55.85 V（电流 232 A，超过 BMS 限流 150 A）。再换一个前，先测 FR 输入端与电池端子在负载起步时的电压。

parts.claim: Remote code 7 is an FR motor controller fault.
parts.why: Code 7 is real, but it comes from an FR DC bus under-voltage trip (54.3 V < 55.0 V), not a motor or inverter internal fault.
parts.observed_at: chassis CAN log (MCU_FR and VCU events)

evidence.quote: 2026-10-28T07:42:02.450 MCU_FR_Event  ERROR DTC 0x2A11 DC bus under-voltage (54.3 V < 55.0 V for >= 50 ms), torque disabled
2026-10-28T07:42:02.500 VCU_Event     ERROR FaultLevel=3 MotorFault_FR=1: torque cut on all wheels, EPB apply, Remote_Code=7

parts.claim: The controller replaced on 10/21 may also be faulty, so replacing it again will fix the problem.
parts.why: The fault returned after the swap. FR sits at 54.36 V while FL, RL and RR read 55.37-55.43 V with the pack at 55.89 V and 232.5 A. A real bus sag is visible. Whether the new unit is defective is not visible.
parts.observed_at: chassis CAN log, MCU DC_V and BMS_Status

evidence.quote: 2026-10-28T07:42:02.450 BMS_Status    Pack_V=55.89 Pack_I=232.5 SOC=38 DCL_A=150 T_cell_min=2 T_cell_max=4 SOH=91

parts.claim: Only FR is abnormal, so the cause is specific to FR.
parts.why: FR reads about 1 V below the other inverters (54.37 vs 55.45 V at line 1409-1410) and is the only one below 55.0 V. The others are only about 0.4 V above the threshold, with the pack still sagging.
parts.observed_at: chassis CAN log, MCU DC_V

hypotheses.claim: A cold, low-SOC pack with a 150 A discharge limit sags below 55 V under launch current.
hypotheses.because: Pack_V 55.85 V at 232.1 A against DCL 150 A, cell 13 at 2.664 V, 2-4 °C. The pack is already near the threshold before the FR offset.

hypotheses.claim: HSA feed-forward pushes torque past the BMS limit, so current exceeds DCL.
hypotheses.because: TqCmd_Out 124.0 against TqLim_BMS 80.2 with HSA_Active=1 on 2.4.1.

hypotheses.claim: The FR inverter has a fault or a mis-set undervoltage threshold.
hypotheses.because: The unit was already replaced and the fault returned. FR follows a real bus drop. The new unit was not tested directly.

hypotheses.claim: High resistance in the FR supply path makes FR see the lowest bus voltage.
hypotheses.because: FR is 0.7-1.1 V below FL during the ramp. This fits a resistive drop, but a sensing offset cannot be excluded from CAN data.

next_check.action: Measure voltage at the FR inverter input versus the pack terminals during a loaded launch.
next_check.why: Separates a supply-path drop at FR from a pack-level sag or an FR sensing error, before another controller is replaced.
how: Put a DMM or scope on the FR inverter DC input and on the pack terminals.
Run the B-ramp launch, cold if possible.
Compare the FR input drop with the FL input drop.
Inspect and torque-check the FR DC cable lugs and connector.

outcomes.label: FR input about 1 V below pack and FL
outcomes.means: There is a resistive loss in the FR supply path, on top of the pack sag.
outcomes.then: Locate the loss; repair the cable or connector.

outcomes.label: FR input equals FL, CAN reads lower
outcomes.means: The FR controller's voltage sensing reads low. This brings back the FR hardware area.
outcomes.then: Check FR calibration; consider replacing it.

outcomes.label: All inputs equal and near pack voltage
outcomes.means: The cause is the pack and torque side; the FR wiring is not the cause.
outcomes.then: Test a capped HSA torque or a warmed pack.

still_unknown: Whether the new FR controller's voltage sensing is accurate
Resistance of the FR DC supply path under load

payload.message: 我不认为是 VCU 的问题。VCU 扭矩仲裁里，输出一定会被 BMS 限扭（TqLim_BMS）卡住，TqCmd_Out 不可能超过它。2.4.1 只是加了坡起辅助（HSA），不会让电池过放。请用数据说明。

steps.label: Read the report and earlier results

result.reply: 数据不支持“TqCmd_Out 一定被 TqLim_BMS 卡住”。10/28 的 VCU 日志里 TqCmd_Out=124.0,而 TqLim_BMS=80.2,同时 Pack_I 232.1 A,高于 DCL 150 A。看起来限幅只作用在基础扭矩上,HSA 前馈是在限幅之后叠加的。这是推断,日志看不到 VCU 内部代码。HSA 不是“过放”,而是电流超限造成压降。

parts.claim: TqCmd_Out can never exceed BMS torque limit TqLim_BMS.
parts.why: On 10/28, TqCmd_Out is 124.0 and 125.2 against TqLim_BMS 80.2. It equals TqReq_Base plus TqHSA_FF (79.0+45.0). Earlier 10/09 with no HSA is clamped at 80.2.
parts.observed_at: VCU_TqDebug on chassis CAN

parts.claim: The 2.4.1 HSA addition does not push the battery beyond its limit.
parts.why: With HSA_Active=1 and torque above the limit, the pack current reaches 232.1 A against DCL 150 A, and BMS warns. Actual torque follows the command. Causation is inferred.

parts.why: SOC stays 38 across the ramp, so it is not deep discharge. The pack voltage sags under overcurrent, and FR then trips undervoltage at 54.3 V.
parts.observed_at: MCU_FR_Event and BMS_Status on chassis CAN

hypotheses.because: Pack_V falls to 55.85 V at 232.1 A with cell 13 at 2.664 V and 2-4 °C cell temperature.

input.reply: 10/09 has the same cold start: SOC 35, DCL 150 A, cells 3-5 °C. The difference is current, not the pack. payload.message: 那现在应该先改软件还是先换件？怎么验证是真的修好了，而不是过两周又偶发？

steps.label: Read the report and earlier results

result.reply: 建议先改软件:把 HSA 前馈限制在 BMS 的 DCL 之内。清洁并紧固 FR 端子成本低,但最好分两次测,才能分清各自的作用。暂不换控制器,也不换电芯 13。验证不能只看“没再停车”,要看冷晨起步时 Pack_I 不超过 150 A、四路 DC_V 最低值离 55.0 V 有余量,并且要连续多个冷晨。

parts.claim: Software (cap HSA feed-forward within DCL) should be done before swapping any part.
parts.why: On 2.3.8 the current was about 150 A with the pack at 61.68 V. On 2.4.1 it was 232.1 A with the pack at 55.85 V and DCL still 150 A. The cap targets that gap, but the log cannot show VCU internals.
parts.observed_at: BMS_Status and VCU_TqDebug on chassis CAN

evidence.quote: 2026-10-09T07:38:22.600 BMS_Status    Pack_V=61.68 Pack_I=151.7 SOC=35 DCL_A=150 T_cell_min=3 T_cell_max=5 SOH=91
2026-10-28T07:42:02.400 BMS_Status    Pack_V=55.85 Pack_I=232.1 SOC=38 DCL_A=150 T_cell_min=2 T_cell_max=4 SOH=91

parts.claim: Cleaning and re-torquing the FR terminal alone would be enough to fix it.
parts.why: At 232.1 A the FL inverter still read 55.45 V, close to the 55.0 V threshold. The pack itself fell to 55.85 V, so the margin stays thin even with FR equal to FL.
parts.observed_at: MCU DC_V and BMS_Status on chassis CAN

parts.claim: A fault-free stretch of a couple of weeks would prove the fix works.
parts.why: The warm afternoon launch drew 247.8 A with DCL 300 A and no fault. Warm days pass whether or not the fix works. Only cold, low-SOC mornings test it.
parts.observed_at: BMS_Status on chassis CAN, 10/28 afternoon

evidence.quote: 2026-10-28T14:10:07.500 BMS_Status    Pack_V=66.51 Pack_I=247.8 SOC=61 DCL_A=300 T_cell_min=18 T_cell_max=20 SOH=91

parts.claim: Replacing the FR controller again or cell 13 is needed now.
parts.why: The trip was a real bus-voltage drop (DTC 0x2A11 at 54.3 V). The log cannot show the new controller's internals or the cell 13 resistance. Neither replacement is supported yet.
parts.observed_at: MCU_FR_Event and BMS_Cell on chassis CAN

evidence.quote: 2026-10-28T07:42:02.450 MCU_FR_Event  ERROR DTC 0x2A11 DC bus under-voltage (54.3 V < 55.0 V for >= 50 ms), torque disabled

hypotheses.claim: A cold, low-SOC pack (weak cell 13) sags under launch current. This is an enabling condition.
hypotheses.because: Cold pack with DCL 150 A sagged to 55.85 V at 232.1 A. The warm pack (DCL 300 A) held 66.51 V at 247.8 A.

hypotheses.claim: HSA feed-forward is added after the BMS clamp, so current exceeds DCL.
hypotheses.because: TqCmd_Out 124.0 against TqLim_BMS 80.2 with 232.1 A. BMS_Event WARN reports 174 A above DCL 150 A. Pre-OTA current stayed near 150 A.
hypotheses.observed_at: VCU_TqDebug and BMS_Event on chassis CAN

hypotheses.claim: The FR inverter has a fault or a mis-set undervoltage threshold.
hypotheses.because: The trip follows a real bus drop, and the other three inverters read only slightly higher. The inverter was not tested directly.

hypotheses.claim: High resistance at the FR terminal makes FR the lowest bus voltage and the first to trip.
hypotheses.because: FR reads below FL at peak current (54.37 V vs 55.45 V), and the engineer measured an oxidised terminal. It decides which inverter trips first, not why the current overshoots.
hypotheses.observed_at: MCU DC_V on chassis CAN plus engineer measurement

next_check.action: Flash the HSA-capped build, leave the FR terminal as is, and run a cold loaded launch.
next_check.why: Separates the software cause from the terminal contribution. It also gives a baseline margin for judging the later terminal fix.
how: Wait for a cold, low-SOC morning like 10/28 (cells 2-4 °C, SOC 38) with DCL still 150 A
Launch on the B-ramp, logging Pack_I, Pack_V and all four DC_V at 50 ms
Record peak Pack_I and the lowest DC_V across the four inverters
Repeat on several cold mornings, then clean and re-torque the terminal and repeat

outcomes.label: Pack_I at or below DCL, min DC_V well above 55 V
outcomes.means: The software path is the main cause. The terminal is a secondary margin issue.
outcomes.then: Clean the terminal, repeat, then roll out the fix

outcomes.label: Pack_I within DCL but FR still trails FL
outcomes.means: The overshoot is fixed but the FR terminal still costs margin and needs service.
outcomes.then: Service the terminal and compare the FR-FL gap

outcomes.label: Pack_I still above DCL despite the cap
outcomes.means: The HSA path is not the only source of excess current, or the cap is not working.
outcomes.then: Re-read VCU_TqDebug and look for another torque path

still_unknown: Whether other vehicles on VCU 2.4.1 show the same overshoot
What the cell 13 resistance and the FR terminal resistance are after service
